question: Which of the following communities of Sikkim celebrates ‘Sonam Lochar’ as its New Year on the first day of the twelfth month in the lunar calendar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamang **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
**Tamang:**

 
 
• The Tamang community of Sikkim celebrates Sonam Lochar as their New Year.
 
• It falls on the first day of the twelfth month of the lunar calendar.
 
• The festival is marked by traditional dances, cultural performances, and religious rituals.
 
• It is a significant cultural event for the Tamang people, reflecting their unique traditions and customs.
 
• The festival is deeply rooted in their Buddhist beliefs and practices.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Kirat Khambu Rai:**

 
 
• The Kirat Khambu Rai community celebrates their New Year as Udhauli and Ubhauli.
 
• These festivals are related to agricultural cycles and the migration of birds.
 
• They are primarily associated with the worship of nature and ancestors.
 
• The festivals hold a strong cultural and spiritual significance for the Kirat community.
 
• These festivals are heavily linked to their unique form of animism.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Lepcha:**

 
 
• The Lepcha community celebrates Losoong (Namsoong) as their New Year, which coincides with the Tibetan New Year, Losar.
 
• It is celebrated after the harvest season.
 
• The festival involves traditional dances, rituals, and the offering of prayers.
 
• It is a time for family gatherings and cultural celebrations.
 
• The Lepcha people have a strong connection to nature, and this is reflected in their festivals.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Gurung:**

 
 
• The Gurung community celebrates Lhosar as their New Year.
 
• It is based on the lunar calendar and is a time for cultural celebrations and family gatherings.
 
• The festival involves traditional dances, rituals, and the offering of prayers.
 
• The Gurung community have a rich cultural heritage.
 
• Lhosar is a very important festival for the Gurung people.
